evals.prompt: Build a product card component for an ecommerce grid: image, title, price, add-to-cart button. It must work on mobile and desktop.
evals.expected_output: Should colocate the component files, follow the design system tokens, implement a responsive layout, keyboard-accessible button with visible focus, and avoid generic AI-aesthetic choices.
assertions: Uses design system tokens instead of hardcoded values
Implements a responsive layout for mobile and desktop
Add-to-cart button is keyboard accessible with visible focus state

evals.prompt: Our checkout form has icon-only buttons for removing cart lines, no labels, and error messages that appear only as red borders. Fix the accessibility.
evals.expected_output: Should add accessible names to icon-only buttons, associate error messages with inputs via aria-describedby (not color alone), and ensure the whole flow is keyboard operable.
assertions: Adds accessible names to icon-only buttons
Associates error text with inputs instead of relying on red color alone
Ensures error messages are exposed to assistive technology
Keeps the full interaction keyboard operable
Meets WCAG contrast and naming requirements

evals.prompt: Add a filter sidebar to our catalog page with category checkboxes, a price sort dropdown, and live result counts. Manage the state cleanly.
evals.expected_output: Should implement thoughtful state management for filters, keep the sidebar responsive (collapsible on mobile), announce result-count changes accessibly, and match existing interaction patterns.
assertions: Implements clean state management for filter selections
Sidebar collapses or adapts on mobile viewports
Matches the project's existing interaction patterns
Checkboxes and dropdown follow accessible authoring practices
